verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Model APIs serve 'supported language models' and that users can deploy open-source or Hugging Face models themselves via Truss and config.yaml. Nothing documents how quickly newly released open-weight models are added to the hosted catalog, such as day-zero availability or turnaround after release. Self-deploying a model is a developer building block, not catalog freshness, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release
